details.note: The LE/TE sweep, rake rise and tip upsweep in w19A/w26K match _7282 and _7250. The aileron now runs to 30.4, close to the TE kink. There is nothing new to change.

details.detail: Surface detail: seams, fastener rows, slat band, gear stripe
details.note: The fastener rows now render a shade under the paint: in w17K the row at y 282 is #979fab on #a4acb8 skin, so it is fixed. The LE head dots are added. The wing still reads clean CG next to _7242, which shows dense fastener dots, spoiler texture and small stencils. That is minor at window range.

line #4f545b is lighter than before. From 26K the spoiler hinge line and chordwise breaks still read as continuous dark outlines with the same weight as the TE gap. In _7250 they are faint, broken hairlines.

The canoes are now flat-sided wedges, deepest at the TE, with a pointed tail. From 26K the part behind the TE is about 2.2x the TE depth, against about 2.5-2.9x in _7250, and the shading (lit flank, dark belly) reads like _7250/_7282. This is a big step up. Small remaining point: from 19A they read as dark saw-teeth because the shaded flank dominates. That is mostly lighting.
Unchanged. The fairing ridge rises into the LE as in LALF _137 and KN Aviation 7A.

details.detail: Nacelle geometry (cowl, lip, splits, strake, access panel)
details.note: The access panel is now a rounded rectangle on the inlet cowl, which is right. Its shape is wrong: it renders at about 3:1 (41x14 px in w11A), while LALF _136 shows about 1.25:1 (75x60 px) from the same angle and KN 7A shows a near-square. It is also small, about 0.18 of the split-to-lip distance against 0.31 in _136. The strake now reads as a lit edge over a shadow band, as in _137 and s13A.

The splits are now dark hairlines, matching _136/_137. The lip is neutral: #d8dde1 in w11A, no longer blue. The cowl reads white and neutral. The GE monogram is added, but it sits at 3.55 m aft, where none of the 11 views shows it. In KN 7A and IQCFQpV it sits low and further forward, on the fan cowl about level with the front of the strake.

The liner is graded, but the visible inner barrel is still near-black: #121214 / #171e2a / #252c39 in w11A and #161819 in w11K. Photos show a mid-grey lit inner lip (#869bb0 -> #81858e in KN 7A) fading to #363530 before the fan. The inlet still reads as a black hole.

The ink is now blue, but it renders a saturated mid blue: #415e9c in w26K and #4c67a0 in w17K, from code #15264a. The ink/skin luminance ratio is 0.48 (26K) and 0.58 (17K). In _7250 the ink is a near-neutral dark slate (#323b40, B-R +14, ratio 0.25). At grazing angles the sky specular lifts the dark decal. The glyph strokes are cleaner now.
There are now 14 dischargers per side, and the rake comb is visible in w19A, as in _7282 and Sam Chui _37. At night (n19A) the nav light is a small red point, which is fixed.

The strake no longer flickers into a dashed line. There is no z-fighting at the splits. One small issue remains: in w17K the new LE head dots (0.08 m dashes) and the slat line turn into a dotted fringe along the far leading edge.

issues.problem: The ink renders saturated mid blue, not near-neutral dark navy, and is still too light.
issues.evidence: w26K darkest ink #415e9c (ratio 0.48) and w17K #4c67a0 (0.58), against _7250 #323b40 (B-R +14, ratio 0.25). Code ink #15264a r 0.6: the sky specular at grazing angles lifts it about 3x.
issues.fix: In 11_exterior.js, set the ink to `const ink = { c: '#0b1220', r: 0.9, m: 0 };` (a matte decal, so less sky mirroring). Re-sample w26K and aim for a ratio of 0.25-0.35 with B-R under +30. If the shader still adds a flat spec, also darken the base to #070b14.

issues.problem: The visible inner barrel is near-black, so the inlet reads as a hole. The photos show a lit grey inner lip fading to dark grey before the fan.
issues.evidence: w11A #121214-#252c39 and w11K #161819, against KN 7A #869bb0 -> #81858e (inner lip) and #363530 (deeper), and LALF _136 #56606a.
issues.fix: Change the inlet to `{ c: '#7d838a', r: 0.5, m: 0.2 }` and the grading to `shadeVerts(B, vIn, B.vcount, (p) => 0.35 + 0.65 * (1 - smooth(0.0, 1.4, p[2] - E.x0 - WING.dz)))`. This puts the bright end at the lip and dark toward the fan. Check the sign of p[2] against the lathe orientation: the lip end must be the bright one.

issues.problem: The rounded rectangle is about 3:1 and undersized. The photos show about 1.25:1, close to square, and about 0.3 of the split-to-lip distance.
issues.evidence: w11A panel 41x14 px against LALF _136 75x60 px from a matching angle. KN 7A shows a near-square.
issues.fix: In the access-panel ring, change the axial half-extent 0.25 to 0.21 and the circumferential term `0.16 / 2.05` to `0.21 / 2.05` (about 0.42 x 0.42 m). Move the centre from 0.85 to 0.80. Use a squarer exponent (0.4 -> 0.3) and outline `{ c: '#6a7077' }` so it holds at range.

issues.problem: The spoiler hinge line and chordwise breaks still read as continuous dark outlines (a tile look).
issues.evidence: w26K crop: every spoiler edge is a solid dark line of the same weight as the TE gap. In _7250/_7331 the breaks are faint and the only strong line is the spoiler-TE/flap gap.
issues.fix: Split `line` in two. Keep `line` for the spoiler TE. Add `const brk = { c: '#7a7f86', r: 0.95 }` for the hinge line and chordwise breaks, at width 0.012 instead of the default.

issues.problem: At 3.55 m aft and -35 deg it is outside every QA view. The photos show it low, further forward on the fan cowl.
issues.evidence: KN 7A (b5_knav_..._9) and IQCFQpV_T1A show the monogram low on the inboard cowl, about level with the front of the strake, at about 1.8-2.2 m aft of the highlight. No r5 view shows the model's monogram.
issues.fix: In the GE monogram block, set xc 3.55 -> 2.0 and ac -35 deg -> -30 deg. Check it from w11A/w13A: it should sit low between the first split (1.3) and the strake's forward end.

issues.problem: The new 0.08 m dashes along the LE turn into a dotted fringe at the far wing.
issues.evidence: w17K crop: a dotted edge along the far LE beyond s about 20.
issues.fix: In the head-dot loop, limit the dots to `s < 22` or fade them out (lerp the colour toward the paint for s > 18). Or make them 0.05 m wide and 0.12 m long so they stay sub-pixel.

issues.problem: The skin is very clean. The photos show dense fastener dots, darker spoiler panel texture and small stencils.
issues.fix: Optional: add 2-3 small red/black stencil rectangles (0.3x0.1 m) near the walkway and gear stripe, plus a faint second fastener row at 35 % chord. Low priority at window range.

issues.problem: The sunset wing renders saturated royal blue (s26K #2f3a8a-ish). The 19A canoe flanks are in deep shade.
